## Laboratory 02 - Step 1/4

### Set up and define the network boundary

No earlier lab or Azure account is needed. **Reuse your existing private copy; do not copy again.**

**Four-step map:** 1 setup/design → [2 network + create Actions](02.md) → [3 outputs + checks](03.md) → [4 PR, live inspection, update and cleanup](04.md). Instructions are inside these steps, not a separate activity.

### 1. Install, sign in, copy and clone

1. Use the [Windows installer](https://github.com/alvinea28/ws2-workshop-catalogue/blob/dev/docs/windows-setup.md#2-paste-this-one-command) or [official installers](../../docs/toolchain.md) for Git, desktop VS Code, Node **24.16.0**, Terraform **1.16.1** and actionlint **1.7.12**. Reopen VS Code after installation.
2. Create/verify your personal [GitHub account](https://github.com/), sign in and accept the instructor's invitation/SSO. In VS Code **Accounts**, sign into GitHub/Copilot; **Manage Extension Account Preferences...** selects your assigned account and seat.
3. On the [public source](https://github.com/alvinea28/ws2-network-module-laboratory-02), choose **Use this template → Create a new repository**. Select your authorized **Owner**, unique name ending `laboratory-02`, **Private**, **Include all branches** off. Open your copy's automatic **Exercise**.
4. Copy **your copy's Code → HTTPS** URL. In desktop VS Code: **Ctrl+Shift+P → Git: Clone → paste URL → parent folder → Open** (macOS: **Cmd**). Complete only trusted sign-ins you initiated. Trust this clone, not its parent; **Explorer** must show the lab root, not a ZIP/browser workspace.

![Microsoft reference showing the GitHub clone picker](../../docs/images/vscode-clone-github.png)
*REFERENCE — Microsoft, CC BY 3.0 US; example, not evidence. [Attribution](../../docs/images/NOTICE.md).*

### 2. Check tools and branch

Set [repository-only authorship](../../docs/start-here.md#set-authorship-only-for-this-repository). At **Terminal → New Terminal**, clone root, run separately:

```powershell
node --version
terraform version
node scripts/doctor.mjs
```

Resolve doctor `CHECK` messages. From the clean actual default branch, normally `dev`, use **Git: Create Branch... → lab/network**, or reuse that existing branch. Keep `WORKSHOP_AZURE_ENABLED=false`; do not create main.

### 3. Write and publish the decision

Read [variables.tf](../../variables.tf) and [versions.tf](../../versions.tf); preserve types, validations, AzureRM **5.4.0** and locks. Edit [exercise/design.md](../../exercise/design.md): heading **Reuse decision**; explain **network baseline** owns one VNet/named `web`/`data` subnets, while **subnet-security** separately owns NSG/rules/associations. The caller owns the existing RG, provider, credentials and state. Remove `TODO`.

**Save → Source Control → inspect diff → Stage Changes** for the design only → **Commit → Publish Branch/Push** to your copy. Refresh the same Exercise.

**Expected:** the design gate advances; incomplete resource/output CI may still fail.

**Recovery:** check clone, branch and pushed text; use [setup help](../../docs/troubleshooting.md), never weaken tests.

**Next:** [Step 2](02.md).
